summary: Build 15 QA regression fully verified end-to-end on the preview mirror. Backend: 5/5 pytest checks green — admin login returns role 'admin', player login returns role 'player', GET /api/v1/account with token preserves role for both users, password-reset returns safe generic message. Frontend UI (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 375x667): (1) POSITIVE admin gating on /account — 'Owner account' label, 'OWNER TOOLS' eyebrow, and testID account-admin-console-button all present exactly once after signing in as qa.owner.b15@vaultpop.test. (2) Admin sees testID settings-admin-console-button on /settings. (3) NEGATIVE gating verified — after sign-out and player sign-in, /account shows 'Player account' with zero account-admin-console-button, and /settings shows zero settings-admin-console-button. (4) Shop VaultPass resilience: hero renders disabled 'Currently Unavailable' button, unavailable caption (testID shop-vaultpass-unavailable), and 'Retry Loading Products' (testID shop-catalog-retry-button); pressing retry gracefully re-runs the load and remains in the unavailable state — no crash, no blank screen, no error boundary. DAILY REWARDS, BOOSTER FORGE, and COIN PACKS & UPGRADES sections all render. (5) Regression: Account Sync as player shows 'Account synced.' status pill; Forgot password returns the safe reset-instructions message; no red-screen errors. AdMob banners and StoreKit unavailability on web preview are expected per constraints and are NOT reported as bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/screens/shop-screen.tsx and any style that uses textShadowOffset/textShadowColor/textShadowRadius.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Fires on every screen. Non-blocking. Reference examples: /app/frontend/src/screens/shop-screen.tsx:651 (theme card overlay LinearGradient uses pointerEvents in style — OK) but other components still pass pointerEvents as prop; search 'pointerEvents=' across /app/frontend/src to migrate.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate legacy `pointerEvents` prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` across React Native components to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional cleanup: migrate `textShadow*` style props to the shorthand `textShadow` to silence deprecation warnings.

No functional fixes required — all Build 15 acceptance criteria (admin gating positive & negative, VaultPass 'Currently Unavailable' + retry resilience, sync/forgot-password regressions, backend role response) are green.
critical_code_review_comments: account-screen.tsx correctly guards Admin Console with profile.account.role === 'admin' and uses Linking.openURL(ADMIN_CONSOLE_URL) — safe.
settings-screen.tsx mirrors the same role gate under ACCOUNT — consistent.
shop-screen.tsx loadCatalog() properly handles StoreKit failure via try/catch, sets catalogState='unavailable', and re-runs on retry press without leaking sessions (mountedRef + sessionRef guarded).
Backend /api/v1/auth/login and /api/v1/account both return the persisted role verbatim; no client-side role forging is possible.
Minor: shop-screen.tsx is ~1000 lines; consider splitting VaultPass hero and RewardCard into separate modules for maintainability (not blocking).
